title: Bollywood Actor Pradeep Rawat Dies at 74, Cause of Death Revealed
summary: Pradeep Rawat, a veteran Bollywood actor known for his villainous roles in films like 'Lagan' and 'Gajan', has died at the age of 74. He passed away on Tuesday evening due to complications from cancer. The cause of death was confirmed by his family members. Rawat's career spanned over four decades, with notable roles in several South Indian films.
